independent_implementation.name: FFmpeg libavfilter ebur128 filter
independent_implementation.version: ffmpeg version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 (Ubuntu system package already installed in the build environment; not downloaded)
independent_implementation.options: ebur128=metadata=1:peak=true, values read from lavfi.r128.* frame metadata (3 decimals); true peak from the maximum of lavfi.r128.true_peaks_chN (linear)
independent_implementation.independence: separate code base and authors from SoundCraft's meter; both implement ITU-R BS.1770-4 / EBU R128 / Tech 3342; neither is a certified reference
independent_implementation.not_used: official EBU test WAV files (not reachable from this environment); signals are generated from the published case descriptions

tolerances.basis: agreement between the two implementations: EBU Tech 3341 ±0.1 LU for I/M, Tech 3342 ±1 LU for LRA; true peak ±0.3 dB because oversampling filters legitimately differ (BS.1770-4 allows +0.2/−0.4 dB against the analytic value). Where the analytic value is known each implementation is also checked against it with the same tolerances.

cases.signal: stereo 1 kHz sine, −23 dBFS per channel, 20 s, 48 kHz
stereo 1 kHz −36 / −23 / −36 dBFS for 10 / 60 / 10 s (relative gate)
stereo 1 kHz −72 / −23 / −72 dBFS for 10 / 20 / 10 s (absolute gate)
5.1 (L R C LFE Ls Rs), 1 kHz −30 dBFS in every channel, 20 s: channel weights 1,1,1,0,1.41,1.41
stereo sine at fs/4 (12 kHz), amplitude 0.99, phase 45°: samples at ±0.70, true peak −0.09 dBFS (inter-sample)
stereo noise bursts (fixed seed, low-passed), 0.5–2 s at −12…−30 dBFS separated by silence, 60 s
